chihuahua.definition:
n. a city in northern Mexico in the state of Chihuahua; commercial center of northern Mexico
n. a state in northern Mexico; mostly high plateau
n. an old breed of tiny short-haired dog with protruding eyes from Mexico held to antedate Aztec civilization
chihuahua.translation: n. 吉娃娃(一种产于墨西哥的狗)

chihuahuan desert.translation: [网络] 奇瓦瓦沙漠；奇瓦瓦荒漠
